html:
The Marrithiyel are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in country south of the Daly River toward the west coast.

Their language, also called Berringen, has several dialects, among them Marri Amu, which is now part of a revival project. Neighbours on the map include the Malak Malak, the Ngan'gimerri and the Murrinh-Patha. Many Marrithiyel people came to live at the Daly River mission and at Wadeye in the 1900s. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Marrithiyel are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in country south of the Daly River toward the west coast.
